correctness.rationale: Independent infinite uniform label streams realize iid uniform complete strict rankings; exposing each RSD prefix only to its first available label yields an iid uniform coupon stream stopping at first coverage. Earlier agents cannot envy later and a later agent envies an earlier selected label iff that label is a repeat in their exposed prefix. Hence the RSD count equals singleton coupons pathwise. The established DA raw-proposal coupon coupling proves the DA count identity. Position-wise conditional avoidance factors multiply and telescope to r!/product(n-i_t+t). Exact arithmetic checker independently verifies n=1..12 via state recursion and coefficient algebra and n=1..4 by exhaustive conditional rank profiles. Coupon law, variance and exponential limit explicitly credited to source papers. Assumptions, n=1 boundary and fixed-versus-random RSD order checked; finite checks are not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Known identical harmonic means for DA and RSD conceal potentially different stochastic inequity risks. The new count-law identity equates every threshold event and all moments for all market sizes, despite allocation mechanisms differing; the indexed joint formula precisely quantifies positional dependence and enables direct design-side fairness risk calculations. This is a motivated structural invariance, not a textbook consequence of coupon-collector moments, numerical census, or simple reparametrization.
